name: AMC Holo Edge
description: A holographic foil edge and header strip built from the theme palette, with a sheen that shifts with the pointer or drifts slowly, around a calm, plain body.
useFor: Premium or celebratory regions: a membership or entitlement Form, a rewards Cards region, a year-in-review Chart or a Static Content announcement; also a single featured Classic Report.
helpText: Region template with a holographic foil edge and header strip. The foil is a repeating gradient of the theme palette colors, softened toward the surface color so the title stays readable; a fine diagonal texture and a glint sit on top. The sheen follows the mouse over the region and drifts slowly otherwise; keyboard focus shifts it as well. The body is a plain surface. Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create buttons sit in the header, Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options thicken the edge, switch to a brand foil in primary and info tones or a sunset foil in danger and warning tones, stop the drift, or remove the body padding. Without JavaScript the foil still drifts; under reduced motion it stays still. In forced-colors mode the foil is replaced by a system border.

templateOptions.name: Thick edge
templateOptions.help: A 5px foil edge and a taller header strip, for a single hero region.

templateOptions.name: Brand foil
templateOptions.help: Foil in primary and info tones only, for on-brand pages.

templateOptions.name: Sunset foil
templateOptions.help: Warm foil from the danger, warning and primary palette colors.

templateOptions.name: Static foil
templateOptions.help: Stops the slow drift; the sheen moves only with the pointer.

templateOptions.name: No body padding
templateOptions.help: Removes side padding so reports run edge to edge.
